errors.evidence: The blue line (Final Acc) starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.90, not 0.85.

The blue line (Final Acc) does not show an overall increase. It starts at ~0.90, peaks at ~0.92 (at Initial Confidence 0.98), and ends lower at ~0.87. Describing this trend as a slight increase is incorrect.
The orange line (Δ Acc) begins at an accuracy of approximately 0.90, not 0.88.
The orange line (Δ Acc) does not decrease gradually. It remains relatively stable from 0.95 to 0.98 and then drops sharply at an Initial Confidence of 0.99.
The green line (Initial Acc) rises to approximately 0.13 at an Initial Confidence of 0.99, which is noticeably higher than the stated 0.1.
This statement is an over-generalization, as the orange line (Δ Acc) shows a significant drop at the end, which is more than a 'small fluctuation'.
The legend is located in the top center of the plot area, not the upper right corner.
